SELECT cd_gender, 
       cd_marital_status, 
       cd_education_status, 
       mv_cnt1.cnt AS cnt1,
       cd_purchase_estimate, 
       mv_cnt2.cnt AS cnt2,
       cd_credit_rating, 
       mv_cnt3.cnt AS cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ca.cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN materialized_view_1 mv_cnt1 ON c.c_customer_sk = mv_cnt1.customer_sk
LEFT JOIN materialized_view_2 mv_cnt2 ON c.c_customer_sk = mv_cnt2.customer_sk AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
LEFT JOIN materialized_view_3 mv_cnt3 ON c.c_customer_sk = mv_cnt3.customer_sk AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
GROUP BY cd_gender, 
         cd_marital_status, 
         cd_education_status, 
         cd_purchase_estimate, 
         cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, 
         cd_marital_status, 
         cd_education_status, 
         cd_purchase_estimate, 
         cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
